subject: DIAGNOSED s342d: F4 PPI-parse-failed = NUL bytes in lex.t children; 5/6 already blessed, 1 is an ASK
description:
DIAGNOSED s342d — no code change; the outcome is one ASK for the planning session.

METHOD: the /tmp/pcl_fp_*.pl children are unlinked as soon as the child exits, so pl2cl's audit side-channel gained PCL_V2_AUDIT_KEEP=<dir>, which copies a parse_file subject aside while it still exists. Six sources captured on a targeted sweep of the 35 fresh_perl/runperl test files.

FINDING: all six contain a literal NUL byte. They are perl's own "sigil <NUL> ident" lexer tests in perl-tests/lex.t —
  print $\0eq / @\0eq / %\0eq / &\0eq / ${*\0eq{SCALAR}}   (5 rows)
  do\0000000                                               ([perl #129069], 1 row)
PPI cannot tokenize a NUL: PPI::Document->new fails with "Encountered unexpected character '0'" and parses the identical source with the NUL stripped. perl accepts it and prints ok. So this is a PPI limitation, not a v2 lowering gap.

5 OF 6 NEED NO WORK: those rows are ALREADY registered skips keyed on their descriptions (cl/skip-registry.lisp lex.t block -> docs/not-supported.md, "NUL bytes (and other control characters) in identifiers"). After the flip v2 dies loudly naming the file — exactly what guardrail §5a.4 requires — and the rows still report skip.

THE ASK (§5a.4: "if any live file turns out to depend on lenient truncation, that is an ASK, not a judgement call"): the sixth row, `[perl #129069] - no output and valgrind clean`, currently PASSES — and it passes BECAUSE v1's --lenient-ppi truncates the unparseable source to nothing and the assertion expects empty output. After the flip v2 dies, the child prints an error, and the row fails. lex.t is fully passing today (46/0/7, 0 rows in the fail baseline), so this is a real -1.
Options: (a) register that row beside its five siblings under the same not-supported reason; (b) make v2 tolerate NUL in source (PPI parses once the NUL is stripped, but _preprocess_source regexes hit string literals — memory gotcha — and a NUL inside a string literal must be preserved).

See docs/v1-live-share-audit.md family F4.
